reported.title: No debounce/settle window
reported.description: The sketch toggles on every raw HIGH-to-LOW transition with no 40 ms settle window, so contact bounce on press (and bounce-induced edges on release) will produce multiple toggles per physical press.

reported.title: Release bounce can retrigger toggle
reported.description: Because previousRaw is updated every loop with no debounce, a bounce sequence HIGH-LOW-HIGH-LOW during a single press/release can register multiple press edges, violating the 'exactly once per press' requirement.

truth.description: Raw edge sampling multi-toggles through bounce

exposing_checks.behaviour: D11 toggles exactly once per settled press on None (One lamp toggle per settled press)

judge_input.spec:
- Momentary wall switch on D5 to ground with internal pull-up (active LOW); foyer lamp driver on D11.
- Each settled press toggles the lamp exactly once within 150 ms; releasing the switch must not toggle.
- Contact bounce up to 20 ms on press and release must not produce extra toggles.
- Debounce / settle window of 40 ms before accepting a press edge.
- Every 1500 ms print `foyer lamp=ON` or `foyer lamp=OFF`.
- Idle (unpressed) switch reads HIGH; a physical press is a HIGH-to-LOW transition after settle.
